task_object.description: Private line name, access port name, and access port resource ID; provide one of the three parameters to identify the private line service object.
task_object.x-a2at-value-constraint: Private line name: the private line object identifier in the network-side EMS NMS. Access port name: the access port name in the network-side EMS NMS, in the format: network element name + board number + board model + port number. Access port resource ID: the access port resource object identifier in the network-side EMS NMS.

task_context.description: Provide the fault phenomenon description of the private line service and the context information of the diagnosis task.
examples: Fault phenomenon: private line interruption. Fault sequence number: fault-id-1-017-20230511-09013
task_context.x-a2at-value-constraint: Fault phenomenon: includes two scenarios, "private line interruption" and "poor private line quality". Required parameter. Fault occurrence time. Optional parameter. Fault or event sequence number on the OSS side. Optional parameter.
